originalTitle: Will perovskite or silicon-peroskite pairs be the most common material for solar panels by 2030?
title: 2030 年全球部署的光伏组件会以钙钛矿或硅叠层为主吗？
Will perovskite or silicon tandems form a majority of solar panels deployed in 2030?
rules: 正文要求 2030 年全球部署的光伏组件中，多数采用钙钛矿或硅／钙钛矿叠层；未说明按组件数、面积还是额定功率统计。
The description requires a majority of panels deployed globally in 2030 to use perovskite or silicon/perovskite tandems; it does not specify module count, area or rated-power weighting.
interpretation: 这是行业部署份额，不能由单一制造商出货或效率纪录推定。
This is an industry deployment share, not one manufacturer’s sales or an efficiency record.

summary: 题目关注 2030 年全球部署材料的多数份额，需要全行业统计以及明确的计量分母。
This concerns a majority share of materials in global 2030 deployment and needs industry-wide data with a defined denominator.
checklist: 核对部署而非累计制造的统计范围。
确认多数份额按什么指标计量。
查看全球年度行业统计与原题澄清。
Review global annual statistics and source clarifications.

impact: 早期商业交付可以表明技术开始进入市场，但全球多数份额还需要跨企业的制造、安装、长期性能与成本竞争力。单个项目不能代表全球采用程度。

Early deliveries show market entry, while a global majority additionally needs broad manufacturing, installations, lifetime performance and competitive costs across suppliers. One project does not represent global adoption.
gap: 原题未定义份额分母，本站不擅自选取组件数或 GW 作为标准。
The denominator is undefined; this archive does not choose module count or GW on the creator’s behalf.

title: 叠层效率、制造产能与实际出货
Tandem efficiency, factory capacity and shipments
principle: 钙钛矿层与硅层吸收不同波段，以提高入射光的利用率。电池效率经过互联、封装和有效面积损失后，才形成组件效率。制造线的额定能力还要经过良率与利用率，才能转为可销售出货。

Perovskite and silicon absorb different spectral bands. Module efficiency includes interconnection, encapsulation and area losses; nameplate factory capacity becomes sales only through yield and utilization.
example: Oxford PV 首批商业组件的 24.5% 效率说明了产品性能，年度 1 GW 则考查累计交付的额定功率。全球多数部署使用哪种材料，还需要统计整个行业的年度装机。
Oxford PV’s first modules had 24.5% efficiency; annual 1 GW concerns cumulative delivered rated power. A global-majority contract needs industry-wide annual deployment data.

label: 规则定义待补充
Incomplete rule definitions
detail: 2030 年全球部署多数份额未明确按组件数、面积或功率统计。
The 2030 global majority is not defined by module count, area or power.
